lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Talk about the picture and match.

details: Talk about the picture encourages students to use their knowledge of the target language to describe what they see.  Match gives students controlled practice identifying the target language and showing their understanding of the questions What is this? and How many … have Tom and Izzy got?
Look for correct matching of the items in the picture dictionary strips to the same items in the main scene and accurate use target vocabulary.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p57 - Cut and stick.

details: Cut and stick allows students to practise their fine motor skills and gives controlled practice of the target language by placing the cut out items on the pictures.
Look for correct handling of scissors and careful cutting out, careful placement of stickers.
